findings.issue: Piel of lemma 6605 b is the engrave/carve stem; «abrirás» supplies the open-sense and omits that action.
שֹׁהַם is a common noun, not a proper name; «shóham» leaves the lemma untranslated.
«las» marks the stones definite; the construct has no article and שֹׁהַם is an indefinite common noun.
«ellas» is feminine while the suffix is 3mp; it still refers to the stones.

notes: tomarás matches qal weqatal 2ms; Israel is the locked name; את is unmarked.
